dish: cliff-side Lake Erie seafood; elaborate Sunday brunch
w: Lakewood's iconic fine-dining landmark since 1965 — a Vernon Stouffer creation built into a bluff and shaped like a luxury liner's hull, with floor-to-ceiling Lake Erie views. Cleveland Magazine's 'Classic Cleveland Restaurants' and 2025 Silver Spoon Award winner; AAA Four Diamond, Wine Spectator Best of Award of Excellence, and a repeat OpenTable Top-100 brunch in America. Sustainable seafood.
sources: Classic Cleveland Restaurants: Pier W (2025 Silver Spoon Award)
Destination Cleveland — Pier W, Lake Erie cliff-side seafood

w: The Lakewood original that launched Matt Fish's grilled-cheese empire in 2006 and drew national fame via 'Man v. Food' and 'Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.' The flagship—and last remaining—location closed New Year's Day 2025; the company has teased a possible future return. Kept flagged for its story, per the guide's closed-places rule.
sources: Melt Bar and Grilled Closed its One Remaining Location (Lakewood)
News 5 / Fox 8 — Melt Lakewood closes, teases return

dish: fine French prix-fixe (steak frites, coq au vin, escargot)
w: Brandon Chrostowski's acclaimed French restaurant that doubles as a culinary training program for formerly incarcerated people — featured on '60 Minutes' and 'CNN Heroes,' and Chrostowski won the 2025 James Beard Foundation Impact Award. Named to Cleveland Magazine's 25 Best Restaurants; relocated in early 2025 from Shaker Square into the former Nighttown space at the top of Cedar Hill.
sources: James Beard Foundation Impact Award 2025 — Brandon Chrostowski / EDWINS

dish: Middle Eastern mezze; zhug (Yemeni chile sauce), hummus, kebabs
w: Chef Doug Katz's high-energy Cedar-Fairmount mezze spot, named a Best New Restaurant in America by Esquire and a fixture on Cleveland Magazine's 25 Best; Katz was a 2026 Best of the East 'Best Chef' finalist. No reservations, worth the wait. (Yemeni/Israeli-leaning — distinct from the guide's stated Persian gap.)
sources: Esquire Best New Restaurants — Zhug (Doug Katz)
Cleveland's 25 Best / 2026 Best of the East finalist — Zhug

dish: veg-forward diner fare, falafel, and thick milkshakes
w: A Coventry Village institution since 1972 — one of Greater Cleveland's oldest and most-loved vegetarian-friendly restaurants, eclectic enough for vegans and meat-eaters at the same table. A cleveland.com-reviewed local landmark of the Coventry arts strip.
sources: cleveland.com restaurant review — Tommy's, Coventry Village
Cleveland Scene — Tommy's, Coventry vegetarian institution since 1972

dish: Progress Pilsner and Citramax IPA in a 320-seat beer garden
w: Sam McNulty's Ohio City anchor brewery (2011), right across from the West Side Market — a 320-seat brewpub with a 3,000-sq-ft American beer garden, three fireplaces, and a rooftop patio, plus a full production brewhouse. A cornerstone of Ohio City's Brewing District and a regular on Cleveland Magazine's best-breweries guide.
sources: Cleveland's 28 Best Breweries: Market Garden Brewery
Cleveland Scene — Ohio City Brewing District / best breweries

dish: lagers and IPAs on a dog-friendly Lake Erie patio
w: An industrial-chic Detroit-Shoreway brewery in the Battery Park neighborhood on the shore of Lake Erie, founded by Ryan Bennett and Ralph Sgro — a laid-back, dog-friendly taproom with a lakefront patio. Named on Cleveland Magazine's 28 Best Breweries and listed by Destination Cleveland.
sources: Cleveland's 28 Best Breweries: Terrestrial (Battery Park, Detroit-Shoreway)

dish: plant-based cafe fare, house vegan cheeses, and bakery pastries
w: Lakewood's premier all-vegan restaurant, bakery and cafe since 2012, known for artisanal hand-crafted vegan cheeses and fresh-baked pastries. Featured in Cleveland Magazine's Lakewood dining guide and Scene's Essential Lakewood Restaurants — a distinctive edge of the Detroit Ave corridor.
sources: Dining Guide: Lakewood's 24 Best Restaurants — Cleveland Vegan

dish: scratch-made gastropub plates and craft beer
w: A Detroit Ave craft-beer gastropub that helped define modern downtown Lakewood dining — scratch cooking and a deep tap list. A repeat pick on Cleveland Magazine's Lakewood's 24 Best and Scene's Essential Lakewood Restaurants.
sources: Dining Guide: Lakewood's 24 Best Restaurants — Deagan's
Cleveland Scene — 40 Essential Lakewood Restaurants: Deagan's

dish: creative New American plates; famed heated igloo patio
w: Restaurateur Mickey Krivosh's upscale New American spot on a bend of the Rocky River at Lakewood's western edge — elegant plates, specialty cocktails, and an award-winning patio that turns into heated dining igloos in winter. A 2026 Cleveland Magazine Best of the West finalist.
sources: Rocky River's 21 Best / 2026 Best of the West finalist — Georgetown
City of Lakewood / LakewoodAlive — Georgetown, Rocky River bend

dish: moqueca baiana, grilled picanha, pão de queijo, xim xim
w: 'Brazil in Cleveland' — authentic Bahia- and Minas-Gerais-rooted cooking (coconutty moqueca, grilled picanha, feijoada) inside a converted Larchmere church with stained glass and a tented backyard patio. Reviewed by The Infatuation and profiled by Cleveland Magazine; a genuine immigrant-food standout on the Shaker Square edge.
sources: Cleveland Magazine — Batuqui, authentic Brazilian (First Look)

w: Heather Haviland's beloved Tremont brunch cafe — farm-to-table with ingredients sourced within 100 miles, ranked cleveland.com's #1 brunch in Cleveland and featured on Food Network's 'Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives' and 'The Best Thing I Ever Ate.' The Reuben (corned beef, kraut, bread and dressing all made in house) is the signature.
sources: Ohio.org (TourismOhio) — Lucky's Cafe, Tremont (Food Network DDD)
